concerns.location: plan.md:T004 / research.md §2 (YOLOv8 for faces and weapons)
concerns.text: YOLOv8's standard pretrained COCO weights have no 'weapon' class (only 'knife' and 'sports ball' are near-neighbors). The plan says weights 'auto-download from ultralytics CDN' with no mention of a weapon-capable model or class mapping. If default COCO weights are used, weapon ROIs will be systematically undetected or mis-detected, invalidating the weapon-ROI arm of the analysis (and the scene_complexity covariate). Specify which model/classes map to 'weapon' and how detection quality will be validated, or restrict claims to face ROIs.

first_fixation_prob is a binary per-trial event (first fixation lands in ROI or not), yet the plan fits a Gaussian linear mixed model for all three outcomes. A LMM on a 0/1 outcome with ~200 items is statistically inappropriate; a logistic GLMM (or aggregated per-stimulus proportion with binomial weights) is needed for hypothesis (b). The plan mentions Gamma GLMM only for dwell time. Specify the link/function for the first-fixation outcome.

Power analysis uses 'parameters from actual aligned N' with fixed f=0.15, ICC≈0.1 — post-hoc power from realized N is acknowledged as limited, good, but the plan does not state the simulation generates data under the *alternative* using the fitted model structure (random intercepts for participants AND items). Clarify the simulation mirrors the crossed random-effects design, otherwise the power estimate answers a different design than the one fitted.
